title: Staff of Spellpower

sources.title: Arcane Enchantment (+1)
markers: | description = You gain a +1 bonus to [[Spell Save DC]] and [[Spell Attack]] rolls.

sources.title: Arcane Battery
markers: | description = Alleviate the arcane burden of spellcasting with the power of this staff. The next spell you cast doesn't cost a [[Spell Slot|spell slot]].

summary: +2 staff improves spell attacks and saves and can spare a spell slot.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, Versatile, 5 ft melee, Dippable. 1d6 + 2 one-handed or 1d8 + 2 two-handed Bludgeoning plus Strength. +2 to attack rolls.
fields.Arcane Enchantment: +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
fields.Arcane Battery: Toggle on once per Long Rest to cast your next spell without expending a spell slot. A cantrip, item spell or scroll can waste the charge, and the scroll is still consumed. The source reports that the cooldown is per character, so a different wielder can use their own charge.
fields.Acquisition: Raphael’s Vault in the House of Hope. DC 10 Wisdom then DC 20 Arcana to use the gems.
fields.Topple: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn. Prone breaks Concentration and expires at the start of the target’s turn. Topple skips main-hand weapon effects.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
